summary.idleHint: The test takes about a minute. Your camera and microphone are only used while it runs.
summary.runningHint: Keep this page open until every check has finished.
summary.passedHint: Your browser, your devices and your network are ready for a meeting.
summary.partialHint: Some checks were skipped. Allow access to your camera and microphone to test them.
summary.warningHint: Warning: you are not in optimal conditions to use the tool. Your media is not carried over UDP (it falls back to a TURN relay over TCP or TLS), which can degrade audio and video quality.
summary.warningDocLink: Technical documentation for your IT department
summary.failedHint: Open the failed checks below for details, then send the report to your IT department.

help.firewall: If network tests fail, check your browser permissions and network filtering rules (WebRTC, WebSocket, TURN) with your IT department.
